question: What is the meaning of volume fraction of reused or recirculated water used in the production of the product in relation to water reuse or recirculation?
data_point: volume fraction of reused or recirculated water used in the production of the product
description: The volume fraction of reused or recirculated water used in the production of the product refers to the proportion of water that is reused or recirculated in the manufacturing process. This is a measure of water efficiency and sustainability in the production process. It is related to water reuse or recirculation as it quantifies the extent to which water is reused or recirculated in the production process. This measure is important for assessing the environmental impact of the production process and for identifying opportunities for improving water efficiency and sustainability.
